events.1: receiver main entry; first stage and sensor START already completed
events.2: first sensor STROBE rising IRQ observed; not exact physical exposure edge
events.4: SAVE module entered; beginning target timing
events.7: PNG encoding completed; final callback buffer can still need flushing
events.8: photo_fs_finish completed: closed/renamed PNG and card-ready checks
events.9: SD deinit, cache clean/disable, uncached frame validation and final snapshots complete; DONE follows
events.10: immediately before Standby WFI, or awake diagnostic completion park; intent only

phase_markers.timing_limit: Diagnostic software observations; interrupt latency and pulse-call overhead apply. Widths need external qualification; event10 does not itself prove Standby.
